The '''J-1 blaster rifle''' was an experimental [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] created by [[Jinkins]] of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].<ref name="SWG:JJR" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the weapon was awarded to a spacer who joined the Lok Revenants and provided exceptional service to [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and the Revenants.<ref name="SWG:NTPCMC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Nym's Theme Park Content Master Collection}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The J-1 blaster rifle appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JJR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The J-1 blaster rifle was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JJR" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
